# OpenSRM Service Reliability Manifest
# Migrated from legacy NthLayer format
# Original file: search-api.yaml
#
# For more information, see:
# https://github.com/rsionnach/opensrm
#

apiVersion: srm/v1
kind: ServiceReliabilityManifest
metadata:
  name: search-api
  team: search
  tier: high
spec:
  type: api
  slos:
    search-availability:
      type: availability
      target: 99.5
      window: 30d
    search-latency-p95:
      type: latency
      target: 99.0
      window: 30d
    search-quality:
      type: custom
      target: 95.0
      window: 7d
  dependencies:
  - name: search-index
    type: database
    critical: true
  - name: query-cache
    type: cache
    critical: false
  - name: product-catalog
    type: api
    critical: true
  - name: user-profile
    type: api
    critical: false
  ownership:
    team: search
